data.summary: The trino directory contains access control configuration files and security rules defining user permissions, catalogs, and schema access policies for Trino.

file_insights.name: access-control.properties
file_insights.summary: Trino access control configuration specifying the use of the file-based security rules.
file_insights.source_summary: Contains properties setting access-control.name to file, security.config-file to /etc/trino/rules.json, and security.refresh-period to 1s.
file_insights.detailed_description: Defines the file-based access control provider for Trino and points to the JSON rules configuration file with a specified refresh period.
responsibilities: Set refresh period for access control rules

file_insights.name: rules.json
file_insights.summary: JSON rules configuration defining user-specific access control policies for catalogs and schemas.
file_insights.source_summary: JSON structure containing catalogs and schemas array definitions mapping users such as engineer, analyst, and diagnoser to specific catalog access levels like all or read-only.
file_insights.detailed_description: JSON-based rules configuration defining permissions for various users across catalogs and schemas in Trino.
responsibilities: Define catalog access permissions per user role
Define schema and owner permissions per user
Enforce default deny-all policy for catalogs
